records.name: Mairsil, the Pretender
records.oracle_text:
When Mairsil enters, you may exile an artifact or creature card from your hand or graveyard and put a cage counter on it.
Mairsil has all activated abilities of all cards you own in exile with cage counters on them. You may activate each of those abilities only once each turn.

records.oracle_text: Avoidance — Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, exile up to one target nonland permanent you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.

records.name: Asmodeus the Archfiend
records.oracle_text:
Binding Contract — If you would draw a card, exile the top card of your library face down instead.
